text: 1 Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport2 Under the age of 25, have graduated from high school (those who have not graduated at the time of application must provide a pre-graduation certificate, and must obtain a high school graduation certificate before admission at the latest).3 Good conduct, physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders affecting normal learning).4 Nationality requirements: In accordance with the provisions of the Ministry of Education Foreign Letter (2020) 12 document5 English-taught majors do not require applicants to have Chinese proficiency. If the mother tongue is not English, applicants need to provide proof of TOEFL/IELTS scores or other proof of English proficiency.
